So price it now to Brassard, demand his pieces to you in the same line, receipt on the board — then vote him. A seat is taken in points, not in silence. Whoever wronged you still owes you.

At 22 one seat empties and the accused are read off the bottom of the list: 35 and 60. Two factions vote, and every voter in one that holds earns 5 points. A seat is not bought by shouting — it is bought in points, in the minutes before the vote opens.
